messages.author: 40628c22eff95227
messages.subject: Sort and display data with Shiny
parts:
All,

I'm able to load and parse the content of the attached "data.xlsx" in my global.R file without any issues. Now I want to display it using shiny

Questions:

1) In my server.R file, I'm using renderDataTable() to display the data in Shiny (see code below) by sorting/ranking based on the "Capacity" column ... where ToysRUs, McDonalds, Burger King will be on rows 1, 2, 3, etc. So when Shiny displays the data, the resulting output will look like this:

RankCompanyStateCountryCapacity<GoToCoordinates>
1ToyRUsIllinoisUSA400♦
2McDonaldsVermontUSA300♦
3Burger KingTexasUSA299♦
4Cheese Cake FactoryNew YorkUSA280♦
5Abby'sFloridaUSA209♦
6Red LobsterOhioUSA190♦

At the moment, it appears the ranking part is not working because after it displays, the output looks just like the content of the "data.xlsx" file (fails to sort the companies based on Capacity numbers)

2) You see the symbol in the "GoToCoordinates" above? When you click on each of the symbols in the browser, after Shiny fires up, it's suppose to take you to the corresponding "Company"'s lat/long location on the Map.
How can I accomplish that? What I have in the sample code below, with the "Action" option does not work too well. Will appreciate any help!

------------------------ content of "data.xlsx" -----------------------
NumberCompanyStateCountryCapacityLatLong
6Red LobsterOhioUSA1901515
5Abby'sFloridaUSA2091414
4Cheese Cake FactoryNew YorkUSA2801313
3Burger KingTexasUSA2991212
2McDonaldsVermontUSA3001111
1ToyRUsIllinois
USA4001010

--------------------------- code in server.R ----------------------------
output$dataCON <- renderDataTable({
  if("1" %in% input$checkGroup){
   if (nrow(topCompaniesInBounds()) == 0)
      return(NULL)
      dat.LST<-data.frame(
      Rank     = as.character(topCompaniesInBounds()$Number),
      Company  = topCompaniesInBounds()$Company,
      State    = topCompaniesInBounds()$State,
      "Capacity" = topCompaniesInBounds()$Capacity,
      Type     = topCompaniesInBounds()$Type,
      Action = paste('<a class="go-map" href="" data-lat="', topCompaniesInBounds()$lat, '" data-long="', topCompaniesInBounds()$long, '" data-company="', topCompaniesInBounds()$Company, '" data-type="', topCompaniesInBounds()$Type, '"><i class="fa fa-crosshairs"></i></a>',                           sep=""))

     dat.LST <- subset(dat.LST,dat.LST$Type=="MY LIST")
   }else return(NULL)
 }, escape=c(-6))
